description: This Java configuration class defines bean creation methods for various tax-related services in the FineRACT project, including TaxAssembler, TaxReadPlatformService, and TaxWritePlatformService, with dependency injection and conditional bean creation logic.

classes.name: TaxConfiguration
classes.description: Spring configuration class for tax-related beans, responsible for wiring dependencies and defining service beans for tax processing.

methods.name: taxAssembler
methods.description: Creates and provides an instance of TaxAssembler with required dependencies, if missing.

methods.name: taxReadPlatformService
methods.description: Creates and provides an instance of TaxReadPlatformService, defaulting to TaxReadPlatformServiceImpl, if missing.

methods.name: taxWritePlatformService
methods.description: Creates and provides an instance of TaxWritePlatformService with its dependencies, if missing.

calls: new TaxWritePlatformServiceImpl(validator, taxAssembler, taxComponentRepository, taxComponentRepositoryWrapper, taxGroupRepository, taxGroupRepositoryWrapper)
